analysis: Actual installed FFmpeg decoded all120frames of the genuine Chromium/Dolby8.1 sample and exposed120 RPU metadata records. Every Y/Cb/Cr reshaping curve is a single linear identity piece [0,8388608,0] with denominator2^23 and pivots0..1023; zero nonidentity frames. The genuine source therefore cannot test nontrivial reshaping. Independent Dolby color/reshaping reference remains unprepared; ordinary HDR10-base equivalence is not that oracle. Installedlibplacebo7.360.1/MoltenVK are potential reference tooling, not an executed Dolby reference. This is a fixture/setup prerequisite, not a measured negative for separate Dolby color processing. No inference that Dolby color matrices, dynamic trims or overall appearance are identity; only reshaping polynomial claim is established. Build.json records exact expanded compiler command.
